before_start: After the user says ready, check process identity, object type and owner pointers. Rediscover if stale. Announce the start. Do not record while waiting for readiness.
stop_policy: Stop automatically at 20 seconds, on selected actor identity loss, game exit or a STOP file. No done message is needed. Do not automatically restart after death/retry.
after_stop: Confirm recorder stopped and summarize valid observation span, raw button edges, candidate action transitions, metadata failures and sampling gaps.
limitations: No validated HP/death detector. Actor invalidation detects object loss/replacement, not the exact frame of death. Button functions and actor labels remain candidates pending calibration.
